subject: Is it possible to request the Yuan-Bentler scaled statistic when comparing models in anova()?

messages.author: ce77ef4ebc3cf5bc
messages.subject: Is it possible to request the Yuan-Bentler scaled statistic when comparing models in anova()?
parts: If I have a set of nested models (say testing for measurement invariance) that are fit using estimator="MLR", when I compare them the function notes that 'method="satorra.bentler.2001"'.  I tried writing anova(model1, model2, method="yuan") but no luck.  Doesn't throw an error, but it just returns the same Satorra-Bentler correction.  Is there a way to compare the Yuan-Bentler values, or do I just need to do it by hand?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to request the Yuan-Bentler scaled statistic when comparing models in anova()?
parts: I tried writing anova(model1, model2, method="yuan")

anova() just calls the function lavTestLRT().  You can see the options on the help page:

?lavTestLRT
